scenarios.name: Cell 46 actual gun/can models require aim and E, attach at the muzzle and persist
actual skin ray hits deal 100 twice or one headshot, corpses persist and New game resets them
bullets cannot pass closed grilles, pause or fire without ammunition
boxing cycles jab/cross/hook with high guard between strikes and preserves 200 player HP rules
supplied cargo matches physical bounds, leaves cell lanes clear and uses real wooden stairs
guard strikes have windup, can miss, respect walls/floors and reduce 200 HP until defeat
HP persists through checkpoints, old saves get 200, and searches kneel without replacing AI
stairs support actual player movement, gates are independent, and equipped tools persist
touch pickups, can attachment and Fire pistol consume one round without stuck joystick
48 independent wide gates frame both floors and all rows load real fixtures
rigged officers animate independently, patrol, switch LOD and retain non-lethal dart hits
production assets load from a subdirectory and the game reloads offline
downloaded standalone HTML runs in an offline browser without network requests
new-game cinematic fires once, pauses safely, closes gate and releases a playable checkpoint
Cell 47 key twist, quiet bed, tool, toilet, passage, save and return
reference corridor, fog and gloved grips retain saved equipment through quick slots
mobile pocket icons remain tappable and clear of left controls on small landscape screens
full barred cell fronts retain collision while small doors slide, protect actors and restore
adaptive resolution, paused preset changes and mobile resize never present a cleared frame
noise stays at its impact source; guard reacts while a puzzle is open
two-handed weapon grip follows the active skeleton across officer LOD and returns to idle hands
